name: The Eye of Bhossca
summary: C sends you after the Eye of Bhossca, said to lie within the Scarlet Monastery. The artifact is wanted back at a dead drop near Pyrewood Village.

sections.title: C's Request
sections.body: A note in the chest bears a new request from C, near Pyrewood Village. The Eye of Bhossca is said to be somewhere in the Scarlet Monastery, and C wants it brought back. As at Shadowfang Keep, you are to enter alone. A disguise found on the monastery grounds may make passage easier.

faq.q: Who is asking for the Eye?
faq.answer: C asks you to retrieve the Eye of Bhossca and bring it to a dead drop near Pyrewood Village.

faq.q: Where is the Eye of Bhossca?
faq.answer: C's sources place the Eye of Bhossca somewhere within the Scarlet Monastery.

faq.q: Why does C want the Eye?
aliases: what does C want it for
faq.answer: C calls the Eye of Bhossca an artifact and says it is the latest object of desire.

faq.q: Where do I take the Eye?
faq.answer: You are to return the Eye to C's dead drop near Pyrewood Village.

faq.q: Do I have to go alone?
faq.answer: C requires you to enter the Scarlet Monastery alone and complete the job alone.
C says a disguise may make it easier to get around and suggests looking for one on the monastery grounds.

attribution: In-game quest text: The Eye of Bhossca
